### 16. Puff pastry cinnamon rolls

Surprise the pastry lover in your life to the ultimate birthday treat: a box of cinnamon rolls. This recipe cuts corners by using puff pastry so it's easier and quicker to make.

We love the idea of replacing a standard sponge cake with a sweet bake – turn your hand to making our Chelsea buns or cardamom buns.

### 17. Chocolate-chip cookie ice-cream sandwiches

If cake isn't their thing, chocolate-chip cookie ice-cream sandwiches sure will be. Simply bake a batch of cookies and use two of them to squish into shop-bought ice cream – you'll never look at cookies the same way again!

Feel free to adapt this recipe with their favourite ice cream or cookie flavour.

# 15+ Birthday Cake Alternatives

Do you need cake alternatives to make your birthday unique?

Looking for birthday dessert ideas that go beyond the traditional cake? Whether you’re planning a full dessert table or just want something fun and unexpected, there are plenty of creative ways to celebrate without another slice of frosting-heavy cake.

From easy dessert ideas to crowd-pleasing birthday cake alternatives, we’ve rounded up some of our favorites, ranging from lighter treats to indulgent sweets, that are perfect for birthdays of all kinds. Because when it comes to celebrating, who says cake has to be the only option?

## Crepe Birthday Cake [...] ## Cake Alternatives for Every Occasion

Birthday not for another six months? You don’t need to turn another year older just to try out these recipes— there are plenty of occasions for celebratory treats! Go ahead and swap out the cake for one of these creative alternatives at your next anniversary, grad party, or “just because” night.

That's enough reading for one day. Now go on and treat yourself!

Breakfast? Dessert? Yes. These easy waffle and crepe fillings are sweet, simple, and made for any time cravings. [...] ## Ice Cream Birthday Parties

I scream, you scream, we’ll all scream if we see another ice cream cake at a birthday party (well, maybe not, who doesn’t like ice cream cake?). But some of the best frozen desserts are made of ice cream and deserve their time in the sun, too. The cherry on top? Ice cream also makes a great theme for any birthday party!

## Fresh Fruit Birthday Cakes

Unique, chic, and jaw-droppingly beautiful, these healthy birthday cake alternatives can be made from whatever fruit happens to be in season during your birthday month. For the base, slice out the center of a watermelon, cantaloupe, or honeydew, rounding off the edges by removing the rind. Decorate with patterns of berries, kiwis, grapes, or sliced starfruit. Top with a dollop of whipped cream and a candle.
